Organ harvesting clicks neatly with my headcanon of The Foundation mindset.

We've got a strong handle on what it does, fully consistent behavior, no reason to expect weird interactions…now, how can we make it useful?

I could easily love a tale where harvesting was the original purpose. Maybe a Baba Yaga type too lazy to butcher her Hansels and Gretels herself.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Came because of the cilia thing. Since it doesn't appear to have been properly addressed, unless you somehow distinguish between sinus cilia and the ones in the lungs, anyone who pulls off even one layer is going to need their lungs vacuumed out for the rest of their life; mucous is constantly being produced in the lungs and moved to the top (where it is either swallowed or spit out) by cilia in order to prevent buildup of inhaled particles. Remove the cilia without removing the mucous production, and you get a normal, healthy function that drowns you in your own lung goo. Which, honestly, could make this one better or worse, but should be addressed somehow either way. No vote.
